title: OpenLLMetry is all you need
talk_summary: This is a vendor pitch for OpenLLMetry, an OpenTelemetry extension that auto-instruments LLM frameworks, foundation-model clients, and vector DBs via monkey-patching so traces/metrics/logs flow to any OTel-compatible backend. It contains no measured results, no agent-orchestration specifics, and no techniques beyond 'use standard OTel instrumentation and a collector.'

takeaways.what_they_do: Instrumentations monkey-patch the client library (LLM SDK, vector DB client) so spans/metrics are emitted automatically with negligible latency, instead of hand-adding logging in agent code.
takeaways.evidence_quote: the way these instrumentations work is that they monkey patch the client library that you're using within your application and then emit all the data

takeaways.technique: Token-usage and latency as first-class metrics
takeaways.what_they_do: Treats token usage, latency, and error rate as the GenAI metrics to aggregate over days/users, rather than only per-request logs.
takeaways.evidence_quote: if you're thinking about which metrics we want to see when we are building a gen based applications it's probably things like token usage latency error rate

takeaways.technique: Tracing multi-step agent runs as spans
takeaways.what_they_do: Frames agents/chains/workflows as multi-step processes best observed with distributed traces spanning tool calls and sub-steps.
takeaways.evidence_quote: agents are multi-step processes that me that interact and run tools

takeaways.what_they_do: A self-deployed OTel collector pre-processes telemetry before export: filter low-value data and obscure PII/sensitive fields.
takeaways.evidence_quote: if you want to filter out some data that is not important for you or you want to obscure pii or obscure sensitive data

takeaways.what_they_do: Because data is emitted in a standard protocol, switching observability backends is a config change, not a re-instrumentation.
takeaways.evidence_quote: you're never tied to a specific platform you can easily switch between platforms is just a matter of you know a configuration change
